messages:
marta: Heads-up: ran a quick audit of the admin workbench. Found ~7k accounts where onboarding_state is null. Thinking a targeted hygiene backfill + healthscore recalibration. Can we canary it first?

sam: Absolutely. What canary size? 1k sounds reasonable.

marta: Proposed selector: 
```sql
SELECT id, email, created_at FROM accounts
WHERE onboarding_state IS NULL
  AND created_at >= '2023-01-01'
  AND region = 'NA'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

kevin: LGTM. We'll run via admin-backfill job with canary flag + quota limiter. I'll add a rollback toggle so the playbook runner doesn't get flooded.

lina: Please capture pre/post samples for the onboarding eval promptset — need at least 200 accounts for quality checks.

cs-bot: Job scheduled: admin-backfill v2 (canary=1000, region=NA) 9 job_id=jb_9921 9 scheduled for 2024-05-02T02:00:00-08:00.

marta: Also noticed duplicate playbook triggers tied to contact.email updates. Suspect downstream webhook duplicates.

sam: Logs show repeated receipts: 
```
2024-05-01T21:12:02Z WARN webhook-handler duplicate_fire id=acct_12345 hook=email_update
2024-05-01T21:12:02Z INFO playbook-run queued rule=welcome_nudge account=acct_12345
```

kevin: I'll add an idempotency key to the webhook consumer and make the backfill honor it. Will post a short RFC in #eng-platform after the patch.

marta: Also request a "patch" writing mode for the backfill: only write onboarding_state when null. No overwrites.

sam: I'll open a CS backlog ticket (medium) and own monitoring during the canary window. Will post hourly snapshots here.

marta: I'll DM 5 sample accounts to you for the first sanity checks. Thanks all.
